US.verdict: Changed completely. All four 14 Oct leaders left the organic top 10 (they remain AIO sources). Fresh 2025 and 2026-dated photographer, marketplace and legal guides replaced them. A YouTube video entered at #7. AIO and related searches unchanged in kind.

GB.verdict: Mostly changed. Only kaynorthrupevents.com held. UK agency and package pages rose (perfectweddingsabroad.co.uk, weddingportugal.com packages, theweddingtravelcompany.com at #7). No PAA returned this time. AIO main sources unchanged; the AIO cost line now cites pedropulidophotography.com (2026).

implications: Freshness matters: three of the new leaders carry a 2026 date. Show a visible last-updated date and keep the year out of the H1 but in the Costs tab sources.
Legal-led pages now rank for the primary term: keep the legal quick answer high on the page.
Package and price pages rank in the UK: the region chooser plus 'Check your date' must answer package intent honestly while F003 stays at 0 packages.
Venue specificity still wins: name settings and palaces by region (Parques de Sintra, pousadas) without venue contact details.

new_fact_candidates_for_fact_checker: Beach ceremonies need a maritime police licence (US AIO citing peachperfectweddings.com and onefabday.com, 28 Oct). Verify on an official source before use.
Civil process through a Conservatoria do Registo Civil with a state fee of about EUR 120 (UK AIO citing onefabday.com, thewhiteedit.com, quintadoboiro.com). Verify on justica.gov.pt.
Civil ceremonies conducted in Portuguese with a translator allowed (US AIO citing onefabday.com). Verify.
